name: PlayStation 5 Slim
description: The current PlayStation console in the smaller chassis, with a disc drive, room for a large library, and a DualSense controller in the box.

name: Xbox Series X
description: Microsoft's flagship console for players who want quick loads, native 4K, and access to Game Pass on the living-room screen.

name: Nintendo Switch OLED
description: A hybrid console with a sharper OLED screen for handheld play and a dock for the television. Built for nights that move between the couch and the desk.

name: Pulse 27 Display
description: A 27-inch 1440p panel aimed at fast console and PC play. High refresh, a simple stand, and enough desk presence without taking the whole room.

name: Span 34 Ultrawide
description: A 34-inch ultrawide for players who keep a map, a chat, and the match on one screen. Curved just enough to fill the peripheral view.

name: Field Wireless Controller
description: A wireless pad with a mature grip, trigger locks for shallow presses, and a charging cable in the box. Works on console and PC.

name: Hall Over-ear Headset
description: A closed headset for long sessions. The mic mutes with a flip, and the earcups stay comfortable past the first hour.

name: Tact Mechanical Keyboard
description: A compact mechanical board with hot-swap switches and per-key lighting you can actually turn off. Built for desk setups that stay up late.

name: Glide Lightweight Mouse
description: A light wireless mouse for low-sensitivity players. The shape stays neutral, and the battery lasts through a season of nightly play.

name: Arcade Wireless Controller
description: A second pad for the couch, with a low-profile face and a cable for wired play when the battery runs out.
